content:textarea:2:25.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:2:25.html: The Salvation Army's Summer Day Camp provides youth ages 5-15 with a safe, structured, and enjoyable environment during the summer months. While running, jumping, and playing, kids will meet new friends, have fun and learn about God through Bible study. Summer activities will include (but not limited to) swimming (tentative based on City of Raleigh pool availability), skating, local museum and park visits, on-site Bounce House, and much more.

content:textarea:7:83.html: We will continue to follow all the recommended CDC and Salvation Army guidelines regarding COVID-19 and adhere to all safety practices and procedures.

content:wysiwyg_basic:12:87.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:12:87.html:
• Food & Nutrition Program as presented by Wake County 4H Club & NC State
  • Garden & Farm Club-presented by our local Food Bank staff
  • Campers will enjoy recreation time through staff-led activities
  • Summer activities will include (but not limited to)--swimming (tentative based on City of Raleigh pool availability), skating, local museum and park visits, movies, healthy habits, smart moves, reaching enrichment, power hour, workshops, guest speakers, morning workouts, and more.

content:wysiwyg_basic:15:83.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:15:83.html:
• Morning arrival: all campers will need to be at the center by 8:00 am - 8:30 a.m.
  • Afternoon pickup: all campers will need to be picked up each day by 5:00 p.m.
  • We will use our carpool method for morning arrival and afternoon pickup
  • Payments can be received upon arrival (Parents can also call our office and make credit card payments)

  • Disposal bag lunch (NO lunch boxes)
